finalRuntimeVerification.buildQualification: Local copy of the current Dockerfile prefills /opt/docling-models from immutable existing image f168a8e0, then runs the unchanged model-download and cleanup commands. The unseeded build was canceled in model download after about 25 minutes; it is not recorded as a successful clean download. No caching workaround was committed.

independentReview.reviewer: ChatGPT in the local browser, explicitly requested by the user
independentReview.access: Supplied implementation excerpts and reported evidence only; no independent repository execution
independentReview.disclosure: Codex identified itself as implementation agent and shared rejected candidate, test scope, initial Python mismatch and final cache-build qualification
independentReview.initialFinding: No confirmed defect in chosen OCR policy; inspect timeout termination paths and validate final Python 3.14 runtime
independentReview.timeoutFollowup: No AbortSignal or explicit kill path in execDocling; real Node maxBuffer error is not classified as timeout. Reviewer closed that concern.
independentReview.finalVerdict: Based on supplied evidence, no demonstrated OCR defect requires another code change. Current Python 3.14 runtime checks support the fix; the verified-cache build does not prove fully cold build reliability. Protected release and post-deploy checks remain.
